name: Heat index
definition: Temperature and humidity combined into "feels like" heat
why_it_matters: This is the heat people actually feel. Heat wave health warnings are based on it.
limitation: Combines the daily maximum temperature with daily average humidity, so it is an approximation.

trend.sentence: Heat index has risen by 0.44 °C per decade since 1981. This trend is very unlikely to be chance (p < 0.001).

extremes.sentence: The heat index level that used to be reached about once every 20 years is now reached about once every 2 years (likely range 1.5 to 3 years).

max_trend.sentence: The highest heat index of the year has risen by 0.64 °C per decade since 1981. This trend is very unlikely to be chance (p < 0.001).
max_trend.subject: The highest heat index of the year
max_trend.test: Mann-Kendall (Hamed-Rao, 3 lags) and 95% range must agree

extremes.note: Heat index extremes here run several degrees too high, because the daily maximum temperature is combined with the day's average humidity (afternoons are drier). So we show how much more often extremes happen, not their exact level.
